options: {"monthly_payment":null}: the cast checks nothing, the math gives NaN, and JSON writes null
{"monthly_payment":"NaN"}, which Claude reads as an error and retries
Nothing runs: tsc rejects the cast, because "6%" is not a number
A TypeError at runtime, because a string like "6%" can't be divided by 100
why: as only tells the compiler what to assume; the compiler can't see the model's output. "6%" / 100 is NaN in JavaScript (no exception), and JSON.stringify writes NaN as null, so Claude is told the payment is null.
